description: Current Bullion Premium Index (CC BY 4.0): for each tracked bullion product, today's lowest premium over spot, the dealer median premium, and the 7-day median and minimum of the lowest premium. Palladium is not tracked. Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

metal.description: Metal for the premium index: gold, silver or platinum.

name: get_premium_index

low_pct_7d_basis.description: Present only when the index row lacked any of its 7-day fields. Then the median, minimum and count all come from the stored hourly price history (last 168 points, spot and prices stored to the cent) instead of the index snapshot log, never a mix of the two. Same window and melt band, but a different series, so values can differ slightly from the index's own figures.

low_pct_7d_median.description: Median of snapshot lowest premiums over the 7 days ending at the index timestamp.

low_pct_7d_min.description: Minimum snapshot lowest premium over the same 7-day window.

snapshots_7d.description: Number of snapshots in that 7-day window.

title: Bullion Premium Index
